=== a function
        .syntax unified
        .global f
f:      adds    r0, r0, r1
        bx      lr
=== literal loads and the moves that replace them
        .syntax unified
f:      ldr     r0, =0x12345678
        ldr     r1, =0xff
        ldr     r2, =0x1234
        ldr     r3, =0xffffff00
        ldr     r4, =foo
        ldr     r5, =0x00ab00ab
        ldr     r6, =0xfffe0000
        ldr     r8, =0x12345678
        ldr     r0, =0x12345678
        ldr     sp, =0x100
        ldr     r7, =-1
        bx      lr
=== a pool after an odd halfword is padded with zeros
        .syntax unified
f:      ldr     r0, =0x12345678
        movs    r0, r0
        bx      lr
        .ltorg
        movs    r1, r1
=== a narrow load reaches 1020 bytes
        .syntax unified
        ldr     r0, =0x12345678
        .space  1018
        .ltorg
=== a load past 1020 bytes is 32 bits
        .syntax unified
        ldr     r0, =0x12345678
        .space  1020
        .ltorg
=== a load grows when the code before its pool grows
        .syntax unified
        ldr     r0, =0x12345678
        ldr     r1, =0x12345679
        .space  1014
        b       far
        .ltorg
        .space  2048
far:    bx      lr
=== loads either side of the 1020-byte limit as the code grows
        .syntax unified
        ldr     r0, =0x12345678
        ldr     r1, =0x12345679
        ldr     r2, =0x1234567a
        .space  1008
        b       far
        b       far
        .ltorg
        .space  2048
far:    bx      lr
=== a load whose pool an alignment keeps in reach
        .syntax unified
        ldr     r0, =0x12345678
        ldr     r1, =0x12345679
        .space  1010
        b       far
        @ Zeros, since GNU as pads Thumb-2 code with 32-bit no-ops where
        @ rsasm uses 16-bit ones.
        .p2align 3, 0
        .ltorg
        .space  2048
far:    bx      lr
=== width suffixes
        .syntax unified
        ldr.w   r0, =0x12345678
        ldr.n   r1, =0x12345678
        ldr.w   r2, =0x11111111
        ldr     r9, =0x11111111
        .pool
=== refused: a narrow load that does not reach its pool
        .syntax unified
        ldr.n   r0, =0x12345678
        .space  1026
        .ltorg
=== a thumb pool at the end of the section
        .syntax unified
        .text
        ldr     r0, =label
        ldr     r1, =label + 1
label:  bx      lr
=== adr forward and back
        .syntax unified
back:   nop
        adr     r0, back
        adr     r1, fwd
        adr     r8, fwd
        adr.w   r2, fwd
        nop
        .p2align 2, 0
fwd:    bx      lr
        adr.n   r3, fwd2
        .p2align 2, 0
fwd2:   nop
=== adr to a label not on a word boundary is 32 bits
        .syntax unified
        adr     r0, odd
        nop
odd:    bx      lr
=== adr past 1020 bytes is 32 bits
        .syntax unified
        adr     r0, near
        adr     r1, far
        .space  1016
        .p2align 2, 0
near:   .space  8
far:    bx      lr
=== refused: adr beyond 4095 bytes
        .syntax unified
        adr     r0, far
        .space  4096
far:    bx      lr
=== a Thumb function calling ARM and Thumb code
        .syntax unified
        .global main
        .thumb_func
main:   push    {r4, lr}
        bl      helper
        blx     armhelper
        bl      armhelper
        blx     helper
        bl      puts
        pop     {r4, pc}
        .thumb_func
helper: bx      lr
        .arm
        .type   armhelper, %function
armhelper:
        blx     helper
        bl      helper
        b       helper
        bx      lr
=== a branch to an ARM function is always 32 bits and relocated
        .syntax unified
        b       armf
        beq     armf
        b       near
near:   bx      lr
        .arm
        .type   armf, %function
armf:   bx      lr
=== literal loads of Thumb functions
        .syntax unified
        .thumb_func
f:      ldr     r0, =f
        ldr     r1, =g
        adr     r2, f
        bx      lr
        .type   g, %function
g:      bx      lr
=== adr of Thumb functions defined before and after it
        .syntax unified
        .thumb_func
f:      bx      lr
        adr     r0, f
        adr     r1, g
        adr.w   r2, g
        adr     r8, g
        .p2align 2, 0
        .thumb_func
g:      bx      lr
=== it blocks and the instructions in them
        .syntax unified
f:      it      eq
        addeq   r0, r1, r2
        itt     ne
        addne   r0, r1, r2
        addsne  r0, r1, r2
        ite     cs
        movcs   r0, #1
        movcc   r0, #2
        itete   gt
        addgt   r0, #1
        suble   r0, #1
        mulgt   r0, r1, r0
        lslle   r0, r1, #2
        adds    r0, r1, r2
        add     r0, r1, r2
        it      mi
        bmi     f
        it      lt
        bxlt    lr
        itt     eq
        moveq   r0, r1
        bleq    f
        bx      lr
=== every it pattern and condition
        .syntax unified
        itttt   eq
        addeq   r0, r1
        addeq   r0, r1
        addeq   r0, r1
        addeq   r0, r1
        iteee   ne
        addne   r0, r1
        addeq   r0, r1
        addeq   r0, r1
        addeq   r0, r1
        ittet   cs
        addcs   r0, r1
        addcs   r0, r1
        addcc   r0, r1
        addcs   r0, r1
        itett   vc
        addvc   r0, r1
        addvs   r0, r1
        addvc   r0, r1
        addvc   r0, r1
        iteet   hi
        addhi   r0, r1
        addls   r0, r1
        addls   r0, r1
        addhi   r0, r1
        itte    le
        addle   r0, r1
        addle   r0, r1
        addgt   r0, r1
        itet    pl
        addpl   r0, r1
        addmi   r0, r1
        addpl   r0, r1
=== flags in and out of it blocks
        .syntax unified
        ittt    eq
        andeq   r0, r1
        orreq   r0, r1
        lsleq   r0, r1
        ittt    eq
        mvneq   r0, r1
        muleq   r0, r1, r0
        asreq   r0, r1, #3
        itt     eq
        addseq  r0, r1, r2
        subseq  r0, r0, #300
        ite     ne
        movne   r0, #1
        moveq   r0, #0
        itee    ge
        addge   r0, r1, r2
        sublt   r0, r1, r2
        rsblt   r0, r0, #0
        itt     eq
        cmpeq   r0, #1
        moveq   r0, #300
        ands    r0, r1
        muls    r0, r1, r0
=== a literal pool load and a long branch in it blocks
        .syntax unified
        itt     eq
        ldreq   r0, =0x12345678
        ldreq   r1, =0x12345678
        it      eq
        beq     far
        it      ne
        bne.w   near
near:   .space  4000
far:    bx      lr
=== it in ARM code emits nothing
        .syntax unified
        .arm
        it      eq
        addeq   r0, r1, r2
        add     r0, r1, r2
=== refused: an instruction without the block's condition
        .syntax unified
        it      eq
        add     r0, r1, r2
=== refused: the wrong condition
        .syntax unified
        it      eq
        addne   r0, r1, r2
=== refused: a conditional instruction outside a block
        .syntax unified
        addeq   r0, r1, r2
=== refused: a branch that is not last
        .syntax unified
        itt     eq
        beq     x
        addeq   r0, r1
x:      bx      lr
=== refused: a PC change that is not last
        .syntax unified
        itt     eq
        moveq   pc, lr
        addeq   r0, r1
=== refused: it within an it block
        .syntax unified
        itt     eq
        it      eq
        addeq   r0, r1
=== refused: instructions in an al block
        .syntax unified
        it      al
        add     r0, r1, r2
=== an adr that stays short once an earlier one has grown
        .syntax unified
        adr     r3, l2
        adr     r0, l0
        b       l5
        ldr     r12, =l1
l0:     bx      lr
l1:     nop
l2:     nop
l3:     nop
l4:     bx      lr
l5:     bx      lr
=== growth that an alignment absorbs does not move a later target
        .syntax unified
        adr     r3, odd
        adr     r0, after
        .p2align 2, 0
        .space  1014
after:  bx      lr
odd:    nop
        bx      lr
=== references to symbols in their own section, by binding
        .syntax unified
        .text
        .globl  glob, hid, prot, intl, galias
        .hidden hid
        .protected prot
        .internal intl
        .weak   weak1, walias, whid
        .hidden whid
        .hidden lhid
start:
        bl loc
        bl glob
        bl weak1
        bl hid
        bl prot
        bl intl
        bl whid
        bl lhid
        bl late
        bl lweak
        bl lalias
        bl lwalias
        bl galias
        bl walias
        b loc
        b glob
        b weak1
        b lalias
        b walias
        beq loc
        beq glob
        beq weak1
        beq lalias
        beq walias
        nop
loc:    nop
glob:   nop
weak1:  nop
hid:    nop
prot:   nop
intl:   nop
whid:   nop
lhid:   nop
late:   nop
lweak:  nop
        .globl  late
        .weak   lweak
        .set    lalias, glob
        .set    lwalias, weak1
        .set    galias, loc
        .set    walias, loc
=== references back to symbols in their own section
        .syntax unified
        .text
        .globl  glob
        .weak   weak1
loc:    nop
glob:   nop
weak1:  nop
        .set    lalias, glob
        bl loc
        bl glob
        bl weak1
        bl lalias
        b loc
        b glob
        b weak1
        beq loc
        beq glob
        beq weak1
=== references out of their section, by binding
        .syntax unified
        .text
        .globl  oglob
        .weak   oweak, uweak
        .set    oalias, oloc
        bl oloc
        bl oglob
        bl oweak
        bl oalias
        bl ext
        bl uweak
        nop
        .section .text.other,"ax"
oloc:   nop
oglob:  nop
oweak:  nop
=== data referring to symbols, by binding
        .syntax unified
        .data
        .globl  glob, galias, hid
        .weak   weak1, walias
        .weak   uweak
        .hidden hid
        .set    lalias, glob
        .set    lwalias, weak1
        .set    galias, loc
        .set    walias, loc
base:   .long   loc, glob, weak1, hid, lalias, lwalias, galias, walias, ext
        .long   loc - ., glob - ., weak1 - ., lalias - ., walias - .
        .long   glob - base, weak1 - base, base - weak1, lalias - base, walias - base
        .long   ext - ., uweak - .
loc:    .long   0
glob:   .long   0
weak1:  .long   0
hid:    .long   0
=== default section alignment
        .syntax unified
        .text
        .byte   1
        .data
        .byte   2
        .section .rodata
        .byte   3
        .bss
        .space  1
        .section .text.hot,"ax"
        .byte   4
        .section .data.rel,"aw"
        .byte   5
        .section .init,"ax"
        .byte   6
        .section custom,"a"
        .byte   7
